question: Which of the following is used in photography?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sodium thiosulphate**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sodium thiosulfate 

 
 
• Sodium thiosulfate (sodium hyposulfite), Na2S2O3, is used by photographers to fix developed negatives and prints.
 
• It acts by dissolving the part of the silver salts coated onto film which remains unchanged by exposure to light.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Sodium bicarbonate**

 
 
• Baking Soda is the common name for Sodium Bicarbonate.
 
• Its chemical formula is NaHCO__3.
 
• It is a crystalline white solid that is salty and alkaline.
 
• It is used for cooking purpose, pest control, and as a fire extinguisher. 
 
 

 
• Sodium hydroxide

 
 
• Sodium hydroxide (NaOH) is known as 'caustic soda' and it is a 'high-base' alkali.
 
• It is used in the manufacture of pulp and paper cloth, drinking water, soap, and detergent.
 
• In the field of medicine, sodium hydroxide is used for the treatment, control, prevention, and improvement of diseases.
 
• Sodium benzoate is used as a preservative for carbonated drinks, jams and fruit juices, and pickles.
 
 

 
• ​Sodium sulfate

 
 
• The formula for sodium is – Na+, and Sulphate is – SO42-. So, the formula for Sodium Sulphate is – Na2SO4.
 
• Sodium sulfate is used to dry organic liquids.
 
• As a filler in powdered home laundry detergents. 
 
• **Na2SO4 **is used in manufactured paper, glass, dyes, and pharmaceuticals.
 
• It is often used in its decahydrate form, which is also known as Glauber's salt.
 
• It is also called **salt cake**.
